did.unittitle: Rochester, N.Y. Winton Congregational Church records, 1918-1959.
did.abstract: The Winton Congregational Church was gathered in 1928 at the corner of Winton Road and Farmington Road in Rochester, New York. The Winton Congregational Church remained active until 1951. This collection contains administrative records and membership records for the Winton Congregational Church in Rochester, New York, as well as administrative and membership records for the North Congregational Church.

acqinfo.p: Materials were donated to the Congregational Library & Archives by the New York Conference of the United Church of Christ in 1979; no accession number.

custodhist.head: Custodial History
custodhist.p: Materials in this collection were given to the New York Conference of the United Church of Christ at an unknown time, likely following the church's dissolution. This collection was originally processed as part of the New York Conference records (RG0112) circa 1980.

bioghist.head: Historical Note
bioghist.p: The Winton Congregational Church was gathered in 1928 at the corner of Winton Road and Farmington Road in Rochester, New York. The church may be a successor to the North Congregational Church which was gathered in 1918 and dissolved in 1926. The Winton Congregational Church remained active until 1951. The site of the Winton Congregational Church is now the site of Temple Sion Congregation of Yahweh.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection contains administrative records and membership records for the Winton Congregational Church in Rochester, New York. The collection includes a volume of church records which contains meeting minutes and vital membership records. The collection also includes a folder of membership-related correspondence that followed the dissolution of the church and a folder of materials related to the church's fifteenth anniversary. The record volume also contains administrative records and membership records, as well as a written history, for the North Congregational Church in Rochester.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Materials in this collection have been arranged in chronological order by start date.
